subject: general
question: In which state/UT was the first Khelo India National Ranking Women Archery held in April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Jharkhand__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The** Sports Authority of India** has approved a** total amount of Rs 75 Lakh** to host the **Khelo India National Ranking Women Archery Tournament** over six phases.
 
• **TATA Archery Academy, Jamshedpur (Jharkhand) is successfully hosted the first phase of the tournament on April 12 and 13.**
 
• The tournament had been held across the Recurve and Compound events in the **senior, Junior and Cadet Categories**, and conducted as per the World Archery Rules.
 
• The Archery Association of India (AAI), in collaboration with the Jharkhand Archery Association and TATA Steel, are organising the tournament.
